description: The line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct configurations: en&es (blue), en&el (green), en&bn (pink), and a fourth configuration represented by a red line (labeled in the legend as "en&el" but visually distinct from the green line, suggesting a possible labeling error). The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 23, representing the layer index of a neural network, while the y-axis, labeled "Similarity," ranges from 0.00 to 0.45, indicating the similarity metric being measured. The red line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.07, rises sharply to a peak of about 0.26 at layer 6, then gradually declines to a low of around 0.08 at layer 21 before a steep increase to 0.44 at layer 23. The blue line (en&es) follows a similar trend, starting at 0.06, peaking at 0.25 at layer 6, and then decreasing to 0.05 at layer 21 before rising to 0.27 at layer 23. The green line (en&el) begins at 0.04, peaks at 0.15 at layer 6, and then decreases to 0.05 at layer 21 before rising to 0.30 at layer 23. The pink line (en&bn) starts at 0.04, peaks at 0.15 at layer 6, and then decreases to 0.05 at layer 21 before rising to 0.30 at layer 23. All four lines show a general trend of increasing similarity up to layer 6, followed by a decrease, and then a sharp increase in the final layers.
